children.value: > Fact From Story Two days after his charity event, the “All Too Well” singer was spotted cheering for the Kansas City Chiefs tight end from the box seats at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri.
> > Fact From Story Not only was she seen sitting next to Kelce’s mother, Donna, but she also appeared to yell “let’s f***ing go” in response to Kelce’s third-quarter touchdown reception.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Cheering for someone indicates support for them.
> Fact From Story Fans have spotted Travis Kelce wearing a friendship bracelet with Taylor Swift lyrics on it, just days before she attended his Kansas City Chiefs game.
> > Fact From Story The beads on the friendship bracelet appeared to reference Swift’s song “Vigilante S***” from her 2022 album, Midnights. | Fact From Story

> > > Fact From Story In addition to the Swiftie-themed jewellery, Kelce also wore a white striped shirt with silver chain necklaces, black sunglasses, and black pants for the event. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Wearing clothing or accessories related to a particular person or thing indicates interest in that person or thing. | Commonsense Knowledge

> > Fact From Story The snap showed Kelce posing at the Kelce Car Jam charity event on Friday 22 September, where he was sporting a beaded friendship bracelet that read: “Vigilante S***” | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story The beads on the friendship bracelet appeared to reference Swift’s song “Vigilante S***” from her 2022 album, Midnights.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Wearing clothing or accessories related to a particular person or thing indicates interest in that person or thing.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Wearing something that references someone else is a sign of support or admiration. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge People who attend sporting events together often have a close relationship.
